QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_37

answer.text: Roles and responsibilities, rights and obligations, indemnity, considerations/commissions, distribution of commissions, penal actions, arbitration, scope of services, confidentiality/privacy, and compliance obligations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM XIX-A (pp. 269, 271, 276), the distributor agreement covers roles and responsibilities, rights and obligations, indemnity, considerations and commissions, distribution of commissions, penal actions, arbitration, scope of services and legal clauses, confidentiality/privacy, and compliance with selling, distribution and marketing practices. The Trap: Reducing the agreement to commissions alone, an address, or fund strategy ignores its function as a binding contract that allocates risk, sets conduct expectations, and protects investor and manager interests. Note: Distributors should read each clause carefully before signing, especially indemnity and commission-distribution provisions, since these directly affect their legal and financial exposure.
